key.name: max-opacity
key.description: Opacity of the black overlay when the slider is at its maximum. Keeps the screen from going fully black.

key.name: invert-slider
key.description: When true, dragging the slider right makes the screen brighter, like GNOME's brightness slider. When false, dragging right makes it darker.

key.name: step
key.description: How much one press of a dimming shortcut changes the dim level.

key.name: shortcut-darker
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that dims the screen one step more.

key.name: shortcut-brighter
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that dims the screen one step less.
